meta.name: doc-coauthoring
meta.description: Guide users through a structured workflow for co-authoring documentation. Use when user wants to write documentation, proposals, technical specs, decision docs, or similar structured content. This workflow helps users efficiently transfer context, refine content through iteration, and verify the doc works for readers. Trigger when user mentions writing docs, creating proposals, drafting specs, or similar documentation tasks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按结构化流程协作撰写文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要与他人协作撰写结构化的文档或提案
copy.tagline_en: Collaborate on structured documentation with a guided workflow
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to co-author structured documents or proposals with others

howto.what: Claude 会按三阶段流程引导你协作写文档:先收集背景并提出澄清问题,再逐节头脑风暴、挑选和修改,最后用全新 Claude 对文档做读者测试,检验它对读者是否清晰。
howto.when: 当你说要写文档、起草提案或创建规格时触发;提到 PRD、设计文档、RFC 等文档类型也会触发。

say.text: 我想写一份技术方案,帮我按流程推进。
say.note: Claude 会介绍三阶段流程并开始收集背景。

say.text: 帮我起草一份 PRD,先问我几个澄清问题。
say.note: 进入背景收集阶段,Claude 会先问元背景问题。

say.text: 写完初稿后,用全新 Claude 帮我做读者测试。
say.note: 进入第三阶段,检验文档对读者是否清晰。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you through a three-stage co-authoring workflow: gathers context with clarifying questions, builds each section via brainstorming and iterative edits, then tests the doc with a fresh Claude to verify it works for readers.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention writing docs, drafting proposals, creating specs, or similar documentation types like PRD, design doc, or RFC.

say_en.text: I want to write a technical proposal. Walk me through the workflow.
say_en.note: Claude explains the three stages and starts gathering context.

say_en.text: Help me draft a PRD. Start by asking clarifying questions.
say_en.note: Enters Stage 1 and asks meta-context questions.

say_en.text: After the draft, test it with a fresh Claude for readability.
say_en.note: Runs Stage 3 to check the doc works for readers.
